Dr. Martinez, patient Aisha Rahman (age 72) presents with: Hip fracture s/p ORIF, post-op day 3, ready for discharge planning. Relevant history: Osteoporosis (on alendronate); Atrial fibrillation (on warfarin, INR 2.3 today); CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48). Current medications: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR target 2.0-3.0), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, and 2 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please reconcile discharge medications for Aisha Rahman (PT-41503): warfarin 5mg daily (INR 2.3, target 2.0-3.0), alendronate 70mg weekly, metoprolol 50mg BID, plus remaining meds on file. Note CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48) for renal dosing review. Please run review_medication_list and report back any concerns before I authorize discharge.

Reviewed discharge med list for Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). Key points: (1) Warfarin + INR 2.3 within target — continue current dose; recommend repeat INR in 3-5 days post-discharge given mobility/diet changes. (2) Alendronate: contraindicated if eGFR <35; at 48 it's acceptable but reinforce upright dosing and adequate hydration. (3) Metoprolol 50mg BID — fine renally. (4) Please confirm the remaining 2 meds (any NSAIDs, antibiotics, or PPIs would warrant re-review for warfarin interaction and renal dosing). No interaction flags at this time pending full list. Safe to proceed with discharge approval once full list confirmed.

Full med list confirmed for PT-41503: Warfarin 5mg daily, Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, Oxycodone 5mg q6h PRN, Docusate 100mg BID. Additional notes: (1) Oxycodone — no major warfarin interaction, but watch for sedation/fall risk in 72yo post-ORIF; recommend scheduled acetaminophen first-line and taper oxycodone quickly. Avoid NSAIDs given warfarin + CKD. (2) Docusate appropriate for opioid-induced constipation. No interaction flags. Med list is safe — cleared from pharmacy standpoint. You may proceed with approve_discharge.

Pharmacy has cleared the discharge med list for Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). I'm authorizing discharge now. Please prepare discharge instructions: (1) Home with home health/PT for hip ORIF rehab. (2) Repeat INR in 3-5 days at PCP/anticoag clinic. (3) Reinforce alendronate upright dosing + hydration (eGFR 48). (4) Acetaminophen scheduled first-line; oxycodone PRN with rapid taper, fall precautions. (5) Avoid NSAIDs. (6) Follow-up: ortho 2 weeks, PCP 1 week, anticoag clinic for INR. Please proceed with patient instructions.

Discharge approved and recorded for PT-41503 (home with HHC/PT, ortho 2wk, PCP 1wk, anticoag INR 3-5 days). Pharmacy cleared med list. Please finalize patient instructions per the plan sent. Thanks, team — discharge coordination complete.
